t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are pairs of gnomes that always appear together: Orange and Brown, Green and Pink, Red and Yellow, and Blue and Purple. Other factors outside of their colors don't affect the outcome of mushrooms. Addionally, gnomes will take you to two different forest, one bright with a red basket, and one dark with a yellow basket. Specifically, the Orange, Green, Red, and Blue gnomes take you to the bright forest, and the Brown, Pink, Yellow, and Purple gnomes take you to the dark forest. It's up to me to figure out which gnomes take me to the forests that bring me the most mushrooms. The number of mushrooms, however, can vary.

vb_textbox.text: Hi! I will try to keep this thorough and brief. First, you should know that the gnomes always appear in the same pairs: Orange and Brown, Green and Pink, Red and Yellow, and Blue and Purple. You may notices changes in their hats or hand movements, but those changes are irrelevant. Another important thing to note is that there are two different forests. One is brightly lit, and it has a red basket. The other forest is darker, and it has a yellow basket. It will be up to you to determine which forest provides you with the most mushrooms. Another bit of information that I can give you is that the Orange, Green, red, and Blue gnomes will all take you to the bright forest with the red basket. The Brown, Pink, Yellow, and Purple gnomes will all take you to the darker forest with the yellow basket. Use this information that I gave you to help determine any patterns you see between the gnomes and the different forests in regards to the number of mushrooms you're receiving. If you start to notice that a pattern you have identified isn't working in your favor anymore, try looking at the information again to determine a new pattern to follow. Good luck!
